subject: Air freight quote to MNL – fastest option
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to MNL (Manila, PH)? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27 at our site in 73523 (Esslingen), Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport.

The shipment consists of 6 pieces of precision instruments, with a gross weight of 352 kg and a total volume of 1.64 cbm.

Please send me your all-in price in EUR, including the pickup, and let me know the earliest possible arrival at MNL.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH
